text:
maria: heads up — HelixOne SI go-live moved to Tue 09:00 PST. Need a short arch review and a checklist for the field team: marketplace image, cert rotation, and final net rules. Can we triage now?

jordan: ack. pulled the runbook. summary: private deployment via VPC peering -> NAT for outbound. main risk = blocked egress to S3 for model artifacts + registry pulls.

sam: @jordan I'll validate VPC/NAT egress today. quick one — are they using our marketplace image or bringing their own container?

maria: marketplace image — they requested signed image + custom runtime args injected by field. they also want a preflight smoke test we can run during staging.

akash: for signed images we need registry access on 443 and our attestation endpoint reachable. Also recommend locking SSH (22) to field jump host only. Proposed port list for their infra:
```
- 443 tcp (registry + attestation)
- 80 tcp (optional redirect)
- 123 udp (ntp)
- 8443 tcp (health probe from our control plane)
- ephemeral outbound to S3 (443)
```
Please confirm if 8443 is OK for health probes — some of their corporate firewalls block high ports.

claire: cert rotation note: HelixOne uses customer KMS. We need to hand off steps for cert renewal and a rollback plan if certs fail on deploy. Suggest embedding a post-deploy check that hits /.well-known/health and validates TLS chain. I can draft the steps.

rachel: telemetry/consent: they said no PII, but field ops asked we disable user-level sampling for first 72h and only capture service-level metrics. We'll need a quick config toggle in the chart.

jordan: action items I hear: 1) sam validate egress & NAT paths, 2) akash confirm port 8443 and registry CIDRs, 3) claire write cert rotation + rollback doc, 4) rachel patch telemetry toggle; 5) maria coordinate field smoke window Tue 08:30 PST.

sam: started traceroute to registry ranges, will post results in this thread by EOD.

akash: checking registry CIDRs now. If they use our CDN front door, we can restrict to 3 ranges — will confirm.

claire: draft for cert rotation posted here: https://redwood.internal/handbooks/si-cert-rotation (pseudo-link for field). It includes a pre-prod test and a fallback with previous cert + svc restart.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket RID-4123 created and assigned to @maria. Scheduled window Tue 09:00 PST (canary -> full). Watchlist: sam, akash, claire, rachel.

maria: perfect. I'll run the field checklist during Tue 08:30 smoke. Sam/akash/claire/rachel please update ticket with your final checks by 17:00 PST today. I'll compile and send to HelixOne. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks — if anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall and tag me. :eyes:

maria: noted. thanks everyone, talk later.
